## Load SNP And Gene Positions

As we need the SNP and gene position for all matrixEQTL runs, we will load them in the beginning, so that we do not have to repeat this step over and over again.

```{r}
# MatrixEQTL does not work without giving the tool the SNP and gene position. 
snpspos <- read.table("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/SNP_locations.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t") # snp chr pos
head(snpspos)
genepos <- read.table("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/gene_locations.txt", header = T, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t") # geneid chr start end
head(genepos)
```


# Preprocess Data

First, we will change the SNP names: remove the alleles of all IDs and change chr:pos to chr_pos (like in Fromer et al. 2016).

```{r, results='hide'}
# change SNP names (for comparison to Fromer)
me.all$cis$eqtls$snps <- unlist(lapply(as.character(me.all$cis$eqtls$snps), function(x) { if(startsWith(x, "rs")){strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1]} else {paste(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], sep = "")}}))
me.scz$cis$eqtls$snps <- unlist(lapply(as.character(me.scz$cis$eqtls$snps), function(x) { if(startsWith(x, "rs")){strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1]} else {paste(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], sep = "")}}))
me.ctl$cis$eqtls$snps <- unlist(lapply(as.character(me.ctl$cis$eqtls$snps), function(x) { if(startsWith(x, "rs")){strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1]} else {paste(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], sep = "")}}))
me.scz.ctl$cis$eqtls$snps <- unlist(lapply(as.character(me.scz.ctl$cis$eqtls$snps), function(x) { if(startsWith(x, "rs")){strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1]} else {paste(strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][1], "_", strsplit(x, ":")[[1]][2], sep = "")}}))
```

Second, we will save only significant cis-eQTLs (FDR < 0.05).

```{r, results='hide'}
eqtls.scz <- me.scz$cis$eqtls[me.scz$cis$eqtls$FDR < 0.05, ]
eqtls.ctl <- me.ctl$cis$eqtls[me.ctl$cis$eqtls$FDR < 0.05, ]
eqtls.all <- me.all$cis$eqtls[me.all$cis$eqtls$FDR < 0.05, ]
```

Third, we will check the number of found eQTLs and unique gene names in all datasets.

|                         | Only SCZ | Only CTL | SCZ & CTL | SCZ & AFF & CTL |
|-------------------------|----------|----------|-----------|-----------------|
| all cis-eQTLs           | `r length(me.scz$cis$eqtls$FDR)` | `r length(me.ctl$cis$eqtls$FDR)` | `r length(me.all$cis$eqtls$FDR)` | `r length(me.scz.ctl$cis$eqtls$FDR)` |
| all unique genes        | `r length(unique(sort(me.scz$cis$eqtls$gene)))` | `r length(unique(sort(me.ctl$cis$eqtls$gene)))` | `r length(unique(sort(me.all$cis$eqtls$gene)))` | `r length(unique(sort(me.scz.ctl$cis$eqtls$gene)))` |
| FDR < 0.05 cis-eQTLs    | `r length(eqtls.scz$snps)` | `r length(eqtls.ctl$snps)` | `r length(eqtls.scz.ctl$snps)` | `r length(eqtls.all$snps)` |
| FDR < 0.05 unique genes | `r length(unique(sort(eqtls.scz$gene)))` | `r length(unique(sort(eqtls.ctl$gene)))` | `r length(unique(sort(eqtls.scz.ctl$gene)))` | `r length(unique(sort(eqtls.all$gene)))` |


# Calculate Distances Between SNPs and Genes in eQTLs

```{r, results='hide'}
### SCZ ###
# add SNP chromosome and position
eqtls.scz <- merge(eqtls.scz, snpspos, by.x = "snps", by.y = "snp", all.x = T)
# add gene chromosome and start and end positions
eqtls.scz <- merge(eqtls.scz, genepos, by.x = "gene", by.y = "geneid")
# check, if chromosomes of SNP and gene are equal
chromosomes <- eqtls.scz[, c("chr.x", "chr.y")]
chromosomes[!duplicated(chromosomes),] # check visually if the chromosomes are exactly the same => TRUE
# get distance between gene and SNP
dist.scz <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls.scz$gene), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls.scz[x, "pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls.scz[x, "start"])){ print(as.numeric(eqtls.scz[x, "start"]) - as.numeric(eqtls.scz[x, "pos"]))} else if(as.numeric(eqtls.scz[x, "pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls.scz[x, "end"])){print(as.numeric(eqtls.scz[x, "pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls.scz[x, "end"]))} else {print(0)}))
head(dist.scz)
### CTL ###
# add SNP chromosome and position
eqtls.ctl <- merge(eqtls.ctl, snpspos, by.x = "snps", by.y = "snp", all.x = T)
# add gene chromosome and start and end positions
eqtls.ctl <- merge(eqtls.ctl, genepos, by.x = "gene", by.y = "geneid")
# get distance between gene and SNP
dist.ctl <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls.ctl$gene), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls.ctl[x, "pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls.ctl[x, "start"])){ print(as.numeric(eqtls.ctl[x, "start"]) - as.numeric(eqtls.ctl[x, "pos"]))} else if(as.numeric(eqtls.ctl[x, "pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls.ctl[x, "end"])){print(as.numeric(eqtls.ctl[x, "pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls.ctl[x, "end"]))} else {print(0)}))
### SCZ & CTL ###
# add SNP chromosome and position
eqtls.scz.ctl <- merge(eqtls.scz.ctl, snpspos, by.x = "snps", by.y = "snp", all.x = T)
# add gene chromosome and start and end positions
eqtls.scz.ctl <- merge(eqtls.scz.ctl, genepos, by.x = "gene", by.y = "geneid")
# get distance between gene and SNP
dist.scz.ctl <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls.scz.ctl$gene), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls.scz.ctl[x, "pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls.scz.ctl[x, "start"])){ print(as.numeric(eqtls.scz.ctl[x, "start"]) - as.numeric(eqtls.scz.ctl[x, "pos"]))} else if(as.numeric(eqtls.scz.ctl[x, "pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls.scz.ctl[x, "end"])){print(as.numeric(eqtls.scz.ctl[x, "pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls.scz.ctl[x, "end"]))} else {print(0)}))
### ALL ###
# add SNP chromosome and position
eqtls.all <- merge(eqtls.all, snpspos, by.x = "snps", by.y = "snp", all.x = T)
# add gene chromosome and start and end positions
eqtls.all <- merge(eqtls.all, genepos, by.x = "gene", by.y = "geneid")
# get distance between gene and SNP
dist.all <- unlist(lapply(1:length(eqtls.all$gene), function(x) if(as.numeric(eqtls.all[x, "pos"]) < as.numeric(eqtls.all[x, "start"])){ print(as.numeric(eqtls.all[x, "start"]) - as.numeric(eqtls.all[x, "pos"]))} else if(as.numeric(eqtls.all[x, "pos"]) > as.numeric(eqtls.all[x, "end"])){print(as.numeric(eqtls.all[x, "pos"]) - as.numeric(eqtls.all[x, "end"]))} else {print(0)}))
```

|                          | Only SCZ | Only CTL | SCZ & CTL | SCZ & AFF & CTL |
|--------------------------|----------|----------|-----------|-----------------|
| significant cis-eQTLs    | `r length(eqtls.scz$gene)` | `r length(eqtls.ctl$gene)` | `r length(eqtls.scz.ctl$gene)` | `r length(eqtls.all$gene)` |
| eQTLs lying on gene      | `r length(dist.scz[dist.scz == 0])` | `r length(dist.ctl[dist.ctl == 0])` | `r length(dist.scz.ctl[dist.scz.ctl == 0])` | `r length(dist.all[dist.all == 0])` |
| min distance all         | `r min(dist.scz)` | `r min(dist.ctl)` | `r min(dist.scz.ctl)` | `r min(dist.all)` |
| min distance not on gene | `r min(dist.scz[dist.scz != 0])` | `r min(dist.ctl[dist.ctl != 0])` | `r min(dist.scz.ctl[dist.scz.ctl != 0])` | `r min(dist.all[dist.all != 0])` |
| max distance             | `r max(dist.scz)` | `r max(dist.ctl)` | `r max(dist.scz.ctl)` | `r max(dist.all)` |
| mean distance            | `r mean(dist.scz)` | `r mean(dist.ctl)` | `r mean(dist.scz.ctl)` | `r mean(dist.all)` |
| median distance          | `r median(dist.scz)` | `r median(dist.ctl)` | `r median(dist.scz.ctl)` | `r median(dist.all)` |


# Plots

## Upset plots of significant eQTL results

Upset plots (like VENN) to compare the datasets with each other:

```{r, eval = F}
eqtls.all.name <- paste(eqtls.all$snps, eqtls.all$gene)
eqtls.ctl.name <- paste(eqtls.ctl$snps, eqtls.ctl$gene)
eqtls.scz.name <- paste(eqtls.scz$snps, eqtls.scz$gene)
eqtls <- list(cases_vs_controls = eqtls.all.name, only_cases = eqtls.scz.name, only_controls = eqtls.ctl.name)
upset(fromList(eqtls), mainbar.y.label = "# genes", text.scale = 2)
```

## Manhattan Plots

1. The easy way using the qqman package:

```{r}

dev.off()

# for CTL only

bitmap("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/manhattan_plot_gene_cis_eqtls_controls.png", "png16m")

dev.off()
```

# Overlap to Fromer DEG

Now, we will check the overlap of our significant eQTLs to the differentially expressed genes in the Fromer et al., Nature 2016 paper.

```{r}
fromer <- read.csv2("/home/karolina/Desktop/PhD/MPIP/workspace/Fromer_top_DE_genes.csv", sep = ";")

intersect(fromer$Gene.Symbol, eqtls.scz$gene)
intersect(fromer$Gene.Symbol, eqtls.ctl$gene)
intersect(fromer$Gene.Symbol, eqtls.scz.ctl$gene)
intersect(fromer$Gene.Symbol, eqtls.all$gene)
```

In Fromer et al. `r length(fromer$Gene.Symbol)` cis-eQTLs with `r length(unique(sort(fromer$Gene.Symbol)))` unique gene names are reported as significant.

|                         | Only SCZ | Only CTL | SCZ & CTL | SCZ & AFF & CTL |
|-------------------------|----------|----------|-----------|-----------------|
| Fromer cis-eQTLs        | `r intersect(fromer$Gene.Symbol, eqtls.scz$gene)` | `r intersect(fromer$Gene.Symbol, eqtls.ctl$gene)` | `r intersect(fromer$Gene.Symbol, eqtls.scz.ctl$gene)` | `r intersect(fromer$Gene.Symbol, eqtls.all$gene)` |

```{r, eval = F}
fromer.eqtls.sva <- fread("/home/karolina/Desktop/PhD/MPIP/datasets/Supplements_Fromer_Paper/eQTL/CMC_MSSM-Penn-Pitt_DLPFC_Analysis_eQTL-adjustedSVA.txt", sep = " ", stringsAsFactors = F, select = c("SNP", "Gene_symbol", "pvalue", "FDR"))
```

# Boxplot of top eQTL with gene expression

Best hit is an eQTL with SNP ID rs151095999 and gene symbol ADGRG7. Now, we will plot the gene expression of this gene in the different alleles. 

```{r}
# Load gene expression dataset
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/RData_Files/4_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_core_gene_summaries_annotated_combat_batch_corrected.RData")
expr <- exprs(geneSummaries)
map <- geneSummaries@featureData@data[geneSummaries@featureData@data$SYMBOL == "ADGRG7", "PROBEID"]
expr <- as.data.frame(expr[map, ])
snp <- read.table("/home/karolina/Desktop/rs115894571.txt")
snp <- t(snp[, 6:length(snp)])

length(snp)
length(expr$`expr[map, ]`)
map

#plot the top 2
library(ggplot2)
library(beadarray)

system(paste0("/storage/groups/ccm01/tools/PLINK/plink --bfile /storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/1.3_merged_chr/pmb_info06_all_chr_merged_dups_removed --snps rs141861617 --recodeA --tab --out /storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/eqtl-gex"))
snp=read.delim("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/genotype_data/5_matrix_EQTL/eqtl-gex.raw",head=T)
load("/storage/groups/ccm01/workspace/MPIP-Dean_postmortem_brain/RData_Files/4_affymetrix_exon_microarray_data_after_rma_core_gene_summaries_annotated_combat_batch_corrected.RData")

exp=as.data.frame(cbind(t(exprs(geneSummaries[featureNames(geneSummaries) =="ADGRG7",])),geneSummaries@phenoData@data$Dx, geneSummaries@phenoData@data$Sex, as.character(geneSummaries@phenoData@data$IID)))
colnames(exp)=c("Dx","Sex","IID")
eqtl=merge(snp[,-c(1,3,4,5,6)],exp,by="IID")
dex0=eqtl[eqtl$Dx==1, ]
dex1=eqtl[eqtl$Dx==2 | eqtl$Dx == 3 | eqtl$Dx == 4,]

a=cbind(as.numeric(as.character(dex0$ADGRG7)),as.character(dex0$rs151095999),rep("Controls",17))
b=cbind(as.numeric(as.character(dex1$ADGRG7)),as.character(dex1$rs151095999),rep("Cases",154))
colnames(a)=c("exp","snp","dx")
colnames(b)=c("exp", "snp","dx")
c= as.data.frame(rbind(a,b))
c$exp=as.numeric(as.character(c$exp))
c$sex_n="males"
c[ c$sex==2,]$sex_n="females"
c.sub= c
c.sub$sex_n="xjoint"
c=rbind(c, c.sub)

pdf("ILMN_1805449_fe.pdf")
ggplot(na.omit(c), aes(snp,exp, fill=factor(Stimulus))) +
  geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~ sex_n)+theme_classic()
ggplot(c, aes(sex_n,exp, fill=factor(Stimulus))) +
  geom_boxplot() +theme_classic()

dev.off()
```
